text:
Maria C: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to add an interactive quota simulator widget (PR #4821). It should illustrate tiered credits, burst allowance, and the new billing-rate calculation for embeddings. Needs: short SDK v4 example, a link to the billing dashboard panel, and a brief note on expected latency vs cost tradeoffs. Pinging @Alex P and @Jon R for review.

Alex P: Thanks — can you paste the exact dashboard panel link? also need the widget design token (colors/width) so it looks right in the sidebar.

Maria C: Panel link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/dashboards/panels/panel-usage-tier-7 (will include final long URL in PR). Design tokens: use --brand-accent and --muted-2, widget width 420px.

Jon R: For the simulator we should surface the hit-rate assumption for cache/batching. I can add a PromQL example to back the numbers. Example I plan to include:

```
sum(rate(api_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",env="prod"}[5m])) by (model)
```

Samir K: FYI, translation/localization: we need short strings only — the simulator labels must be extracted into i18n keys before merge. I'll add a checklist comment on the PR.

Maria C: Good call @Samir K — I'll mark strings with t() and add a translations.md note.

Alex P: Draft SDK v4 snippet (JS) — sanity check please:

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, version: 'v4' });

// simulate quota calc for 10k tokens/day, embedding tier "pro"
const sim = await client.simulator.run({
  type: 'quota',
  workload: { tokensPerDay: 10000, embeddingsCalls: 50 },
  tier: 'pro'
});
console.log(sim.summary);
```

Jon R: Looks fine. Add a short comment about the simulator being a client-side estimation only (not authoritative for billing). Also link to /billing/faq in the note.

Maria C: Will do. Also adding a tiny toggle for burst credits so users can see how burst changes cost. Anyone from eng-sre want to sanity-check the burst math? @Alex P?

Alex P: I will run a quick check tomorrow morning, but the math looks sound from the snippet. Please add a unit test link in the PR referencing infra-tests#997 so reviewers can see regression checks.

DocsBot: Reminder — new PR templates require the checklist filled: documentation, i18n keys, sample snippet, panel link.

Maria C: All checklist items added, PR updated with screenshots and the snippet. @Jon R can you drop the PromQL as a short 'data source' footnote?

Jon R: Done — added the promql and a short paragraph describing assumptions (95th percentile request shape).

Samir K: I left two l10n nits in the PR comments (shorter label for "Burst allowance" and a different pluralization for "credit").

Maria C: Incorporated both nits and pushed a small patch.

Alex P: Reviewed and left one small nit about a heading level and an accessibility alt text for the widget toggle. Otherwise LGTM.

Maria C: Fixed heading/alt text, added tests link and localization key export. Merging in 5m if no objections. :thumbsup:

Jon R: No objections. Thanks for pulling this together.

Samir K: Thanks — will queue translations after merge.

Maria C: Merged and closing the PR. Will follow up with a short announcement in #docs once translations are in. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
